name: 14626-loradecode-7b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine.
load_profile: poisson (open loop), rate=20 req/s, warmup 10%, cooldown 10%, bound 1200 requests, 900 s safety cap, static seed 14626.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`: 128 prompt tokens in, 32 tokens out (min == max on both), one turn, streaming. Prompts are drawn fresh per request and share no prefix. Every request is routed through the LoRA adapter named in scenario.json -- there is no un-adapted traffic. Prompts go on the wire as raw text (`request_format: plain`); the checkpoint ships no chat template.
purpose: A specialized 7B chat assistant serving short streaming replies through one adapter on a single GPU at twenty requests per second.
launch:
# The engine command line. The interpreter and the hardware are in configs/env.yaml, which is
# per-machine and NOT portable.
model: NousResearch/Llama-2-7b-hf

# WHICH adapter is a property of the REQUEST and is declared client-side, in scenario.json
# `spec.backend.lora_modules`: the engine is driven in-process and `--lora-modules` is
# API-server surface AsyncEngineArgs will not take.
enable-lora: true

# 64 is the ceiling the engine sizes its adapter buffers to, not the served adapter's rank (r=8).
max-lora-rank: 64
max-loras: 1

tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: float16
max-model-len: 4096
enable-prefix-caching: false
max-num-batched-tokens: 2048
max-num-seqs: 1024
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
